scope: Read-only current P4 native geometry, placement, visual design language, mechanical and silkscreen completion review. Source PCB unchanged.

metrics.mounts: H1-H4: 2.2 mm M2 plated holes at (+/-19.5, +/-19.5), 39 mm square pitch

design_language: Compact rounded-square module with four symmetric corner mounts and perimeter connectors.

Strong repeated power-cell organization: U1/U2/U3 at x=12.85 mm and y=1.2/8.7/16.2 mm; corresponding shunts R3/R1/R5 at x=5.85 mm and y=0.7/8.2/15.7 mm. Preserve this visual and electrical repetition.
Power input and phase connector along the right edge; USB/CAN along the left edge; external feedback at the lower edge. Conversion and brake circuitry occupy the upper area.
U4 MCU/driver at (-5.1,7.2) on front with dense analog passives on the back; U601 encoder locked at (0,0) on back. Placement aims to keep control to the quiet side of the aligned power column.
Routing is still sparse, mainly short local breakouts and several parallel diagonal paths; this is a partly placed and partly routed layout, not a final copper style.

findings.title: Finish placement before committing to the 45 mm outline
findings.evidence: 98 footprint origins remain outside the actual board; see placement_inventory.json and all-placement maps.
examples: Entire 54-position 10 uF DC-link bank C101-C103 and C110-C160, including six DNP positions, staged at x=67.91..101.81, y=-11.26..18.49 mm; C104/C105/C106 and R101 also staged.
U701 BMI323 and local components around (-70.32,33.73).
TH701 (42.985,-9.965), TH702 (34.975,3.225), TH703 (34.975,17.225); phase snubber pairs and C3/C7/C11 staged to the right.
J502 brake NTC (-89.38,10.845), DC-link TVS/damping parts, and several feedback/temperature network parts remain staged.
findings.action: Place retained parts by function, starting with local DC-link capacitance, commutation loops, phase thermal sensors and optional tuning footprints. Check whether the full architecture fits the current envelope while preserving central encoder and mechanical space. A footprint origin inside the outline alone does not prove all its pads/courtyard fit.

findings.title: Remove bottom-side components from under the centered encoder
findings.evidence: Native geometry and refilled DRC agree: U601 at (0,0) overlaps R309 (0.84,-1.8), R313 (-0.82,-0.5), R314 (0,0). R313 and R314 also overlap each other. All are on B.Cu; placement_back_board.png highlights these in red.
findings.action: Keep the locked encoder centered and relocate the resistors to a clear, short-route location outside its body/courtyard and the magnet envelope.

findings.confidence: high for courtyard intersections; physical mating clearance remains unverified
findings.title: Resolve connector and mounting conflicts
findings.evidence: Refilled native DRC reports J101/H2, J1/H3, Q301/J802 and Q301/R304 courtyard intersections. J1 also intersects staged C3/C7/TH702/TH703 outside the outline; those latter intersections are staging artifacts until those parts are placed.
findings.action: Resolve the in-board conflicts and check screws, washers, plugs, mating cables, heatsink and magnet in a complete mechanical assembly. Outboard connector bodies are intentional edge interfaces and do not by themselves prove incorrect placement.

findings.title: Bootstrap capacitor vias land on opposite-net pads
findings.evidence: C203 is on B.Cu. Pad 1 BOOT is (0.515,-20.5375), pad 2 SW is (1.475,-20.5375). A 0.5 mm BOOT via is at (1.635005,-20.5375), over the SW pad; a 0.5 mm SW via is at (0.365006,-20.5375), over the BOOT pad. This independently supports the parent's native DRC short finding.
findings.action: Correct the via/pad routing in the subsequent layout edit.

findings.title: Finish the operational silkscreen and assembly identifiers
findings.evidence: The current board contains no board-level F.SilkS/B.SilkS text objects. Only footprint marks and a minority of reference fields are visible; native views show collisions and clipped lettering. Existing connector polarity/pin-1 graphics are present but there is no complete interface labeling scheme.
findings.action: Add a consistent compact set of board/revision, VM/GND, phase, brake, CAN, feedback, SWD, reset/status and IMU-axis labels. Relocate remaining visible references and trim off-board connector silk; keep orientation marks readable. Review fiducial/assembly access after placement.

findings.title: Update stale layout guides
findings.evidence: User.1/User.2 boundaries still describe the old 80 mm floorplan; Cmts.User includes P3 PLACEMENT and a four-layer F.Cu/In1/In2/B layer-intent sentence. Actual board enables six layers with In1=GND L2, In2=Signals L3, In3=Power L4, In4=GND L5.
findings.action: Regenerate or remove obsolete construction annotations once final placement is established. Do not route by the old guide sentence.

findings.title: Current 3D renders cannot prove mechanical clearance
findings.evidence: J1's custom MR60 footprint has no 3D model. Exported views also omit some declared connector models. No full enclosure, magnet or heatsink assembly was supplied in this review.
findings.action: Resolve model coverage and inspect a full assembly before mechanical release.

limitations: This subreview makes geometry and project-consistency claims, not datasheet, thermal-current-rating, EMC or fabrication-release claims.

Placement maps use native KiCad pad/body/courtyard geometry and top-view coordinates for both sides; they intentionally omit zones and display reconstructed reference labels. Native 3D renders show current source saved geometry and hide off-board staging.
Electrical DRC, refreshed plane-fill assessment, schematic parity and full analysis are handled separately by the parent review.
